the mechanical characterization and the numerical modelling of the mechanical behaviour of a molybdenium-titanium carbide (Mo–TiC) composite for high temperature application.

a realistic modelling of the mechanical behaviour of the composite is possible by using a physically based approach, and that the proposed modelling can be extended to other composite systems.
